semiconductor_relevance: High — Wafer Works Corporation specializes in silicon wafer production, a critical component in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Wafer Works Corporation is a leading supplier of silicon wafers, including polished and epitaxial wafers, essential for semiconductor devices. With over 20 years of experience, the company focuses on providing high-quality materials and innovative solutions to meet the evolving demands of the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.United States: Founded by members with extensive experience in the semiconductor industry in Silicon Valley.
